Please text or call Rick for showings:

This iconic mid-century building offers idyllic views and a fabulous location. Rarely available, this 1,500 sqft, 2 bedroom, 2 bathroom open concept is perfect for entertaining in the newly renovated kitchen complete with a large center island that opens to the living/dining. Floor to ceiling windows border the living room with a private wrap-around deck, allowing for expansive views flooding the space with natural light. The master bedroom is spacious and has an en-suite bath. The guest bedroom has access to a 2nd private balcony. Amenities include 1 car parking, guest parking, storage locker, 24-hour doorman, and laundry. Just steps away from Davies Symphony Hall, Opera House, Japantown, Hayes Valley, Civic Center, and the epicenter for shopping, restaurants, and nightlife. Easy access to the freeway, nearby tech shuttles and a Walk Score of 98.
